日本語の題面。

Problem

Your task is to process some data.
You are given 3 integers a, b, c and a string s.

Constraints

  • 1\leq a, b, c \leq 1,000
  • 1\leq |s| \leq 100

Input

Input will be given in the following format from Standard Input:

a
b c
s

Output

Output the result of a+b+c and string s in one line.

Input Example #1

1
2 3
test

Output Example #1

6 test

Input Example #2

72
128 256
myonmyon

Output Example #2

456 myonmyon
